zayd-hotels.summary: A full-stack PERN hotel booking platform with payments, an owner dashboard and reviews.
zayd-hotels.description: Zayd Hotels lets travellers search, filter and book hotel rooms, and gives owners a dashboard to manage their listings. The React front end talks to an Express API backed by PostgreSQL on Neon through Prisma, with Clerk for auth, Stripe for payments, Cloudinary for images and Resend for emails.
highlights: Owner dashboard to manage hotels and bookings
Image uploads with Cloudinary and emails with Resend

pvc-confort.summary: A multilingual website for a PVC and aluminium joinery company in Morocco, with a blog managed in Sanity.
pvc-confort.description: PVC Confort Maroc presents the company's windows, doors and double glazing services and helps customers ask for a quote. It is built with Next.js and next-intl in French, English and Arabic, with a blog managed in Sanity CMS and a contact form that sends emails through Resend.
highlights: Blog with categories and pagination, managed in Sanity
Sanity Studio built into the site
Contact form with emails sent by Resend
SEO metadata for every page and article

elchapo-store.summary: An e-commerce store built with Next.js and Sanity CMS, live on a custom .ma domain.
elchapo-store.description: An online store built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, with its content managed in Sanity CMS and deployed on Vercel under a custom .ma domain.
highlights: Deployed on Vercel with a custom .ma domain
